title: Difference-in-differences evaluation
purpose: Estimates the effect of AI implementation by comparing change over time in an intervention group with change in a comparison group.
input: `Data` sheet with unit_id, time_period, treated_group, post_period, outcome, and optional covariates.
outputs: Difference-in-differences estimate, regression table, group-time means, parallel-trends visualization, residual diagnostics, and interpretation.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
